scenarios.title: Combat damage from a wither creature to a creature is dealt as -1/-1 counters
decisions: A attacks player B with Cinderbones.
B blocks Cinderbones with Grizzly Bears.
No spells or abilities are used; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: wither_attacker
variants.expected: Cinderbones deals 1 damage to Grizzly Bears as one -1/-1 counter: Grizzly Bears is a 1/1 with 0 damage marked and stays on the battlefield. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Cinderbones, which is destroyed and moves to A's graveyard. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: plain_attacker
variants.delta: A's attacker is Fugitive Wizard (1/1, no abilities) instead of Cinderbones.
variants.expected: Fugitive Wizard deals 1 damage to Grizzly Bears, which has 1 damage marked, no counters, and stays a 2/2. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Fugitive Wizard, which is destroyed. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: unblocked
variants.expected: Cinderbones deals 1 damage to player B, whose life becomes 19. No -1/-1 counters are placed anywhere; Grizzly Bears is unchanged.

scenarios.title: A wither source that has left the battlefield still deals its damage as -1/-1 counters
decisions: B casts Shock targeting Footlight Fiend, tapping Mountain.
A does not respond; Shock resolves and Footlight Fiend (a 1/1 with wither from Corrosive Mentor) dies.
Footlight Fiend's dies trigger goes on the stack with A choosing Grizzly Bears as its target.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: mentor_present
variants.expected: Footlight Fiend is in A's graveyard when its trigger resolves, but it had wither as it left the battlefield. Its 1 damage is dealt as one -1/-1 counter: Grizzly Bears is a 1/1 with 0 damage marked.

variants.label: mentor_absent
variants.delta: Corrosive Mentor is not on A's battlefield.
variants.expected: Footlight Fiend had no wither as it left the battlefield. Its 1 damage is marked on Grizzly Bears: a 2/2 with 1 damage marked and no counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Relies on Forge using the dead source's last known information for its keywords: Corrosive Mentor still affects black creatures on the battlefield but no longer the card in the graveyard.

scenarios.title: A wither spell on the stack deals its damage as -1/-1 counters
decisions: A casts Puncture Blast targeting Craw Wurm, tapping all three Mountains.
Both players pass; Puncture Blast resolves.

variants.label: wither_spell
variants.expected: Puncture Blast deals 3 damage to Craw Wurm as three -1/-1 counters: Craw Wurm is a 3/1 with 0 damage marked and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: plain_spell
variants.delta: A casts Lightning Bolt (tapping one Mountain) targeting Craw Wurm instead of Puncture Blast.
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to Craw Wurm, which has 3 damage marked, no counters, and stays a 6/4.

variants.label: player_target
variants.delta: Puncture Blast targets player B instead of Craw Wurm.
variants.expected: B loses 3 life and has 17 life. B has no poison counters. Craw Wurm is unchanged.
